Devrim checks and re-checks his sniper rifle with a thoroughness that borders on obsession. He looks up as you approach.

"We know that Maya is on the hunt for Golden Age tech, but we suspect that's not the extent of her ambition."

The mortal sniper taps on a data pad, uploading key information to your HUD.

"Empress Caiatl has been generous enough to send in some of her best Psion researchers to investigate. Make sure you check in with them. Hopefully they'll give us enough info to preempt Maya's next move."

3710486535.displaySource:
"For me, there was no return from Crota. I lacked hope. Made me not the easiest to get along with. I knew that. But it didn't matter to Eris. She saw hope in me where I wouldn't. Wanted to say thanks, so I tried to gift her a trinket, but she rejected it. Eris wasn't looking for gratitude; she truly saw hope in us all. On our own, we were nothing. But as she'd always remind us, lost as we might be, true strength came from our union.

"Eris's words rang in my ears as the Hive tore my Light from my soul."

—A loyal friend
